title: AI for All: Operationalising Diversity and Inclusion Requirements for AI Systems
reasoning: The paper identifies religion and ethical directives as core themes in its 'Diversity and Inclusion' (D&I) framework for AI systems. It explicitly includes 'AI Ethical Directives' as one of its 23 unique themes and tests the ability of GPT-4 to generate user stories addressing religious attire (such as hijab and niqab) and religious beliefs in a professional context.
